node.auto-cauldron.desc: A cauldron that makes Plain honey drops by itself every morning, using the day's honey.
node.dark-garden.desc: Dark sunflower seeds, the rare alternate of sunflower seeds, now sometimes come with the morning delivery. Needed for Perfect sunflower candies.
node.counter-space.desc: The shop can welcome more customers each day.
node.contract-board.desc: Merchants post orders with a quantity and a deadline.
node.hive-bond.desc: The hive sends a little more honey, and its visitors fill the shop.
journal.title: Journal
journal.first: The first day. The mice stared at the cauldron for a long while before anyone dared to stir.
journal.quiet: Few came today. The bees hummed something that sounded like sympathy.
journal.busy: A good day. The cauldron still smells of honey and ambition.
journal.rich: The coins piled so high tonight that the youngest mouse used them as a bed.
journal.lost: Some left empty-pawed. Sweet Tooth is patient; customers are not.
journal.clerk: The clerk counted the coins twice, then a third time, just to enjoy it.
journal.garden: The dark seeds whisper at night. Nobody asked what they say.
journal.fallback: Another day, another batch. The shop settles down for the night.

node.errands-board.desc: The hive and the temple post errands with lasting rewards.
node.map.desc: Reveals places around the shop as the weeks go by.
errands.title: Errands
errands.none: No errand is available right now.
errand.queen-fever.desc: The hive queen has a fever. Bring four Fine candy canes. The hive will repay you with more honey, for good, and once she is well the bees will visit your shop.
errand.pilgrim-feast.desc: The faithful plan a feast. Bring eight Fine sunflower brittles and the counter will be widened for good.
errand.rival-hive.desc: Send the clerk to parley with the rival hive for two days. If it works, the honey they steal comes back for good.
map.title: Around the shop
journal.week-passed: The week is over and the target is met. Sweet Tooth stirred in its sleep.
journal.week-missed: The week fell short. No matter: the cauldron is patient and so are the bees.
error.errand-unavailable: This errand is not available yet.
error.errand-not-active: This errand is not under way.

board.ringLegend: Ring on the icon: none = Plain, one = Fine, two = Perfect.

node.sunflower-patch.desc: Sunflower seeds arrive every morning: opens Sunflower brittle, Sunflower nougat and more. Make a recipe by hand twice before the clerk can sell it.
node.sunflower-yield.desc: One more sunflower seed every morning.
node.pulling-machine.desc: Unlocks Excellent quality: more ingredients, a pulling step, a better price.
errand.magic-cauldron.desc: The old cauldron stirs by itself when it is fed well. Bring four Excellent candy canes and it will learn to make Perfect candies from rare ingredients: royal jelly, dark seeds and the like.
error.wrong-candy: This is not what they asked for.
serve.want.rich: A candy with {n} or more ingredients
craft.surplus: Unused ingredients are sold for coins when the shop closes (1 each, rare ones more).
craft.surplusMixed: Unused ingredients are sold for coins when the shop closes (rare ones fetch more).
errand.royal-gift.desc: The queen is well again and the hive wants to thank you with its rarest gift. Bring eight Fine sunflower nougats for the feast and royal jelly will sometimes come with your honey.
node.reputation.desc: Pilgrims talk: every sale brings 6% more, rounded up (at least a coin more on cheap candies), per level.
errand.sweet-tooth-offering.desc: The cult asks for one thing: three Perfect sunflower nougats, made with royal jelly and dark seeds, laid before Sweet Tooth. After that the shop runs on and the cult is pleased.
